stories.headline: ICBA Sues OCC to Stop Alleged Fast-Track of Crypto Bank Charters
stories.body: Independent Community Bankers of America sued the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, alleging that the regulator authorized cryptocurrency firms to enter the banking system without being subject to the same scrutiny as community banks, according to a Friday (Oct. 2) press release from the association. stories.headline: Fed extends deadline for Regulation O comments
stories.body: The central bank extended the deadline for comments on Regulation O by one month, to Nov. 4.

stories.headline: How AI is redefining Wall Street jobs — and boosting demand for this new 'hottest skill' by 1,721%
stories.body: Banks are fueling a hiring surge for AI engineers who are good at "agent orchestration" — the ability to coordinate teams of specialized agents.
